Lecture outline
1 Quick review: scalar Newton, vector Newton, and power flow Newton.
2 Worked example: two complete Newton corrections on one network.
We will track the same three unknowns, three power equations, and tolerance
throughout.
Everynumerical result will connectto the equation, state, and operation that produced
it.

Summary
1 Evaluate f = [𝑃 2 − 0.55, 𝑃 3 + 0.90, 𝑄 3 + 0.30]T.
2 Evaluate each Jacobian coefficient at those same voltages.
3 Solve JΔx = −f and add the correction to the voltage state.
4 Recalculate the original nonlinear equations after every update.
5 Accept only after all selected residuals and active controls pass.
Twocorrections meet this example’stolerance. Thepath matters: each new state
determinesthe next residual andJacobian.
